defense_dimensions.name: 全局上下文防御
defense_dimensions.description: 全局架构或外层已具备拦截校验机制，单点无需过度防御

defense_dimensions.name: 历史兼容与协议约束
defense_dimensions.description: 代码遵循特定历史硬件/网络协议契约约束，非架构缺陷

description: 对整个代码仓进行深度的架构审计与全量存量代码安全质量评估，扫描隐藏的系统性风险
name: deep_review

categories.label: 逻辑与正确性-并发安全
categories.definition: Concurrent access lacks synchronization and can produce an unsafe race or ordering failure.

categories.label: 逻辑与正确性-边界处理
categories.definition: A code path mishandles boundary values or invalid input.
decision_rules: empty, minimum, maximum, or malformed input is possible
positive_hints: bounds and invalid shapes are handled

categories.label: 逻辑与正确性-逻辑漏洞
categories.definition: Implementation contradicts the intended requirement or invariant.

categories.label: 逻辑与正确性-异常控制
categories.definition: Exception or error flow corrupts state, loses diagnostics, or leaves resources unsafe.
decision_rules: error state is swallowed or double-handled

categories.label: 性能与运行效率-内存泄漏
categories.definition: Owned heap memory becomes unreachable before release.
decision_rules: error or loop path omits free

categories.label: 性能与运行效率-资源未释放
categories.definition: A non-memory resource is acquired without a guaranteed close or rollback.
decision_rules: file, lock, socket, or handle is acquired

categories.label: 性能与运行效率-CPU与I/O瓶颈
categories.definition: An avoidable algorithm or I/O pattern creates disproportionate CPU, blocking, or network cost.
decision_rules: I/O occurs inside a hot loop

categories.label: 安全风险-内存破坏
categories.definition: An access or memory operation can overwrite, underflow, overflow, or corrupt valid memory.
decision_rules: unsafe pointer arithmetic or copy exists
bounds are attacker or path dependent
positive_hints: safe API and checked bounds are used

categories.label: 安全风险-敏感硬编码
categories.definition: A credential, key, token, or other secret is embedded in source.
decision_rules: redaction and external config are absent
positive_hints: secret is loaded from secure config
negative_hints: value is a public test fixture

categories.label: 安全风险-输入注入
categories.definition: Untrusted input can alter command, query, path, markup, or protocol interpretation.
decision_rules: delimiter or query context is not escaped

categories.label: 可维护性-魔鬼数字
categories.definition: A semantically meaningful numeric literal is repeated or unexplained.
decision_rules: same value is copied in multiple places
positive_hints: named constant or configuration is used
negative_hints: number is a local indexing convention

categories.label: 可维护性-圈复杂度过高
categories.definition: Control-flow complexity exceeds the level needed for the behavior and impedes safe change.
decision_rules: branch or loop nesting is deep
decision paths are hard to test

categories.label: 可维护性-冗余代码
categories.definition: Unreachable or redundant code obscures active behavior.
decision_rules: condition or branch is provably unreachable

categories.label: 架构与设计-高耦合
categories.definition: A module depends on unrelated implementation details, reducing replaceability.
decision_rules: module reaches into another component internals

categories.label: 架构与设计-职责违背
categories.definition: A component combines unrelated responsibilities and lacks a clear contract.
decision_rules: component changes for multiple unrelated reasons
domain, infrastructure, and presentation are mixed

categories.label: 架构与设计-三方依赖
categories.definition: Third-party dependency use violates its contract or creates an avoidable supply-chain risk.
decision_rules: API is deprecated, unsafe, or misused
version or license is not controlled
positive_hints: approved version and API are used

categories.label: 其它问题-其它架构风险
categories.definition: A credible architecture or review risk that does not fit a more specific controlled category.
decision_rules: risk affects behavior, safety, or maintainability
